_what_this_is: Fixed boilerplate of the Northlight client-brief template, per language. The render model copies these strings character-exact from templates/northlight_client_brief.md (EN) and templates/northlight_client_brief.el.md (EL) and renders only the brief's entries; pipeline/stages.py check_render_template verifies them, so headings and labels are never re-translated per run. tests/test_render_template.py keeps this file and the two Markdown templates in step.
_owner: Agency brief template owner (proposed synthetic default; the bilingual reviewer approves any wording change).
